title: Production comedy script
script: OpenClaw: the personal AI assistant so personal, you must personally survive the installation. It promises your assistant on every device and chat, then arrives with Android, iOS, Kotlin, Swift, Gradle, and several emotional support build systems. The branding has changed from Warelay to Clawdbot to Moltbot to OpenClaw — less a product roadmap, more witness protection. And with token costs, rate limits, and careful configuration, it’s wonderfully autonomous… at generating admin.

title: Production comedy script
script: OpenClaw is the personal AI assistant for every device, every chat, and apparently every identity crisis. It began as Warelay, became Clawdbot, then Moltbot, and finally OpenClaw—less a brand journey, more witness protection for software. The pitch says effortless automation; users report setup that feels like applying for planning permission. And with mobile apps, deployment, extensions, and several build systems, it’s wonderfully personal: one assistant, requiring an entire enterprise. OpenClaw indeed.

title: Production comedy script
script: OpenClaw is the internet’s favourite personal AI assistant, provided you’re personally an infrastructure engineer. It promises your assistant on every device and in every chat, then greets you with Android, iOS, Kotlin, Swift, Gradle, and Shell. That’s not setup friction; that’s an onboarding committee. Even the name has had several upgrades, like an assistant trying to escape its own search history. OpenClaw: your digital helper, now requiring its own digital helper.
